summary.headline: Astrological Aspects and Mutual Aspect
summary.text: Discussion of astrological aspects, ranking conjunction, opposition, quartile, trine, and sextile by strength and judging their benefic or malefic effects according to the planets involved. The commentary distinguishes friendship and enmity aspects, the luminaries, Mercury, the nodes, approximate and exact mutual aspect, and begins examples of sextile mutual aspect involving Gemini, Cancer, Sagittarius, and Capricorn.
